page-title: Pronot'if - Which room are we in?
page-description: Your timetable, your rooms, your homework. Stay informed about everything.
hero-subtitle:
Your timetable, your rooms, your homework.
Stay informed about everything.
reminders-subtitle: Pronot'if notifies you about the many events in your school day.
room-description: A few minutes before each class, receive a notification with information about the room you need to go to.
homework-description: Every evening, get notified if you have unfinished homework due the next day.
lunch-description: Discover the menu before you even sit at the table.¹
cancelled-description: Be the first person to know if a class is cancelled.
footnote: ¹Some features are only available for compatible schools. More information at go.pronotif.tech/compatibility.
feature-1-description: A reminder before every class so you (almost) always arrive on time.
feature-2-description: Connect to your account quickly in just a few steps.
feature-3-description: Everything you need to know about your day on one page.
feature-4-description: Whether you have an iPhone or anything else, the experience is the same.
feature-5-description: Choose which types of alerts to receive and when you want them.
feature-6-description: Add the app to your home screen in just a few clicks.
install-description: Install the app on your device to start receiving notifications.
success-message2: Thank you for installing the app! 🎉
android_step2: In the popup that appears, tap "Install"
android-browser-step: Tap your browser's menu button (•••, ⋮ or ≡)
ios-add-step: Enable "Open as web app" then tap "Add"
android-final: Then open the app from your home screen.
